interface.longDescription: A focused toolkit that turns clarified goals and repository facts into verifiable Agent Skills, plugins, requirement packages, project documentation, and software projects.
defaultPrompt: Use shape-idea to clarify a rough idea before implementation.
Use health-check as the project norm entrypoint; it reports evidence-backed issues first, then repairs and rechecks after confirmation.
Use a specialized build-goals Skill for a confirmed task, or use vibe-coding for end-to-end delivery from a confirmed requirement package.
